title: Universal HotKey
description: This is an auxiliary mod that integrates various practical functions into a hotkey. It is a pure client and highly configurable.
body:
This is an auxiliary mod that integrates various practical functions into a hotkey. It is a pure client and highly configurable mod. The default hotkey is LAlt.

# Features

## Self-rescue
When you fall from a height, look down and press the hotkey to quickly switch items that can reduce damage to the main hand. If there are multiple such items, you can continuously press the hotkey to switch.

![falling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cb7faac38635a0dc3eb98143fac167f3f4b1b99.gif)

## Mining
When visually inspecting a block, pressing the hotkey can quickly switch to the appropriate tool.

![Switch Tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b8d624b53c020f911d8877cdcedfd3af0b022b7.gif)

## Storage
When aiming or opening a container, pressing the hotkey can quickly transfer the same items from the backpack to the container.

![Storage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5254928937177fccb3071a6a41e27a774c103971.gif)

## Combat
When aiming at a creature, press the hotkey to quickly switch weapons to the main hand and shields to the secondary hand. If the distance is far, it will switch to a ranged weapon. If the health value is low and there is an undying totem in the backpack, the undying totem will be switched to the secondary hand.

![Switch weapons when combat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1a80ee2cf93ec0853ef3bbfd057c1066ecbe4f2.gif)

## Interaction
When aiming at a specific block, pressing the hotkey will switch to items that can be pre interactive. This needs to be added in the configuration beforehand.

![Switch interactable items ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78ce36351b2fd60a792a300f14425b34928e8436.gif)

## Placement
When holding the block and aiming at the air, pressing the shortcut key will automatically place the block in the nearest available position.

![Place block when aim air](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc0e6f10849a847841028074791053fe3b2b53dc.gif)
